title: Let praise dye the whole life true
summary: Praise and saintly company dye conduct with truth. Let conduct answer before performance does.
takeaway: Let conduct answer before performance does.
lifeApplication: Before speaking about values again, ask what your treatment of people showed today and choose the cleaner act.

source.shortMeaning: Praise and saintly company dye conduct with truth.
source.lifeApplication: Before polishing the outside, return to praise and one truthful act.

evidence.coreClaim: Praise and saintly company dye conduct with truth.
evidence.turn: Let praise, saintly company, and true action soften the self into homecoming.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before speaking about values again, ask what your treatment of people showed today and choose the cleaner act.
